blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Optimism block 155309915 and Base block 49714630. Both tracked DephaserJPY deployments retained direct runtime code with zero EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots. Their verified ABI/source exposes standard ERC-20 transfer paths, role-gated mint, and allowance-gated burnFrom, but no pause, blacklist, freeze, allowlist, seizure, transfer hook, or privileged arbitrary-holder burn. The earlier PAUSER_ROLE wording was stale: the current verified ABI has no PAUSER_ROLE or pause function. Direct JPYT blacklistability is false. Locked USDC/USDT can be frozen upstream and impair backing or redemption, but those issuers cannot restrict JPYT holder balances.

oracleRisk.summary: DePhaser mints JPYT using Chainlink USD/JPY exchange-rate data for USDT/USDC deposits, with no fallback or failure handling documented.

branchApplicability.rationale: JPYT is issued through fully collateralized USDT or USDC deposits and redeemed by burning JPYT for the deposited asset. The documented flow has no borrower-specific undercollateralized position or liquidation branch to enumerate.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: JPYT is minted natively on each OP Stack chain by DePhaser's per-chain DepositManager contracts (sole MINTER_ROLE holders) against stablecoin deposits routed into Aave; the reviewed mint profile supersedes the earlier canonical-bridge guess.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-3 (lead usds-sky) (2026-07-20)
